ConditionRule.Nausea: −1 to your To-Hit rolls per level. [auto]
ConditionRule.Pinned: Cannot use leg actions or willingly-moving actions; each level past the first costs one limb from your limb economy.
ConditionRule.Paralysis: Gain Enduring Exhaustion on a random limb (1d6) per level.
ConditionRule.Corroded: Take 1 Rend at the start of your turn per level; when you can't be Rended further, remaining levels become Hemorrhage.
ConditionRule.Debilitated: 1× Disadvantage to all To-Hit rolls per level. [auto]
ConditionRule.Pulled: Enduring Prone + Dragged; moved 5ft toward the source at the start of your turn per level; at most one action while Pulled.
ConditionRule.Hemorrhage: Take 1d10 damage at the start of your turn per level. [auto]
ConditionRule.Jinxed: Gain 1 Fumble at the start of your turn per level (applies to your first roll; persists to your next turn).
ConditionRule.Slowed: No 5ft Adjust; −5ft move speed per level; −1 reaction (−2 at 5+); leg actions exhausted at 4+.
ConditionRule.Silenced: Cannot speak or cast spells. Enduring — does not reduce at end of turn; clear it with a Make-Trait-Check action.
ConditionRule.Sting: +1 to all damage you take per level (applied after DR). [auto — full apply with damage pipeline]
ConditionRule.Fatigue: −1 AP per level; no reactions. [auto: AP]
ConditionRule.Frenzy: 1× Disadvantage to every Trait Check per level. [auto]
ConditionRule.Panic: Cannot move toward the Source; 1× Disadvantage on Trait Checks vs the Source per level; at 4+ must spend AP fleeing.
ConditionRule.Taunt: 1× Disadvantage on To-Hit vs anyone but the Source per level; counts the Source as adjacent; can't move away at 4+.
ConditionRule.Fumbled: Reduce your very next d20 by your Fumble count, then clear it; removed at end of turn.
ConditionRule.Rended: Randomly remove 1 AD/PD/TD/MD from a piece of your armor per level; a fully-rended piece breaks.
ConditionRule.Madness: Oracle affliction; at Madness 6 you become Insane.

Hints.move: Move up to your Speed. You can split the move around other actions. You can't move through a creature your size.
Hints.fiveFootAdjust: Boost: move 5ft, before or after the action it's applied to. Once per turn, and not in a turn you Move. Not into difficult or occupied terrain, while Prone, without the use of your legs, or at 0 Speed.
Hints.climb: Climb up to 5× your Power in feet (at least 5ft). If you end your turn holding onto a wall, you can't use reactions or arm actions, and you count as Prone.
Hints.drop: Drop up to 5× your Finesse in feet. Dropping further, or without this action, knocks you Prone and deals falling damage.
Hints.hurdle: Boost to a Move: hurdle a 5ft wall, drop 5ft, or jump a gap of up to 5× your Finesse in feet (at least 5ft) into an empty square. The distance counts against the Move.
Hints.disengage: Disengage from enemies: they can't use a reaction to attack or grab you, even if you make a ranged attack.
Hints.attack: Make an attack: roll 1D20 plus your bonuses (Proficiency, the Trait, and so on). On a hit, deal the weapon's base damage plus its Trait.
Hints.kick: Choose a target within 5ft. They make a Power Check against your Check DC, or are pushed 5ft away into a free square (knocked Prone if there isn't one).
Hints.rendArmor: Make a melee attack against worn armor. On a hit, instead of dealing damage, rend 1 of its PD, MD or TD (your choice).
Hints.switchItem: Swap what you're holding for combat-readied items from your inventory, or pick an item up off the ground with a free hand.
Hints.steady: Steady yourself. Before your next turn you can take a reaction that needs you Steadied, or give one reaction its Steadied benefit (one per Steady).
Hints.hide: Behind Half Cover that could fully hide you: gain full cover from that direction until the start of your next turn.
Hints.help: Choose an ally within 5ft and the action you're helping with. When they roll for it, they roll with 1X advantage.
Hints.makeTraitCheck: Make a Trait Check against a condition or effect. Rolled consistently (with extra AP), each success removes one level.
Hints.focus: Maintain a Focus ability through your turn. If you end your turn without using this, that Focus ends.
Hints.holdAction: Name an enemy, a trigger and the ability you'll use (not a Boost), and spend its AP and limbs now. If the trigger happens before your next turn, spend your Reaction to use it.
Hints.other: Any other action: Flee, Hold Turn, or something the GM allows. (A Consistent Roll's extra AP is asked for when you attack.)
